integrity: The proof uses the primary-source Fredholm determinant criterion and threshold expansion plus explicit algebraic identities of the published dispersion.
Finite computation is not used to establish the infinite-domain claim.
The literature comparison distinguishes statement implication from topical similarity.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic pocket and energy-profile statements are for detuning of gamma at fixed critical coupling mu_0.
The interior energy profile is uniform only on compact subsets strictly inside the limiting pocket.
No claim is made about spectrum inside the essential band or about detuning the coupling parameter.
title: Dual bound-state pockets at a lattice virtual-level crossing
